replies.body:
I thought the server was using a custom no-cheat plugin developed by IvyCode instead of NCP since the Avicore update. I might be wrong.

It would be better if the no-cheat plugin was meant to just prevented fly & no knockback hacks as they are the easiest to detect. Killaura and fastplace/break are hard to detect as lag can make the plugin think the user is hacking when they are not. (Giving unwanted block disappearances and such)
